town.text: Ah, you're back! Good. I've found another gap. Well, not found. More... not found.
Forty-one years, simply missing. Who loses forty-one years? Unless...
Don't touch that pile, it's in order. It doesn't look in order. It is.
If you find anything written down out there, anything at all, bring it to me. Please.
Thirty years reading by ember-lamp, and I can't remember half of what I read. Odd, isn't it?
Old Maud says I ask the wrong questions. She's usually right, which is infuriating.
Ink. Ink doesn't forget. That's the whole... yes. That's the whole point of ink.
Mother Aubrine calls history a matter of faith. I call it a matter of paper.
